description: Formulate the packing problem as a convex second‑order cone programme (SOCP) and solve it with CVXPY, removing the need for handcrafted row patterns.

guidance.idea: Replace the existing linear‑program sweep with a single SOCP that jointly optimises all centres and radii under non‑overlap and boundary constraints.
guidance.transfer_rule: N/A (template for geometric packing / layout optimisation tasks).
actions: Add constraints `cp.norm(c[i]-c[j]) >= r[i]+r[j]` for all i<j and `0 <= c[i] - r[i]; c[i] + r[i] <= 1`.
Set objective `cp.Maximize(cp.sum(r))` and solve with an open‑source SOCP solver (ECOS or SCS).
Replace the old LP call with this new block and return the optimal radii.
cautions: SOCP solvers may be slower for large N; keep N modest (e.g., ≤30).
Check solver status; fall back to the previous LP if the problem is infeasible.
